changelog: - Affiliate partners can be invited by e-mail alone: `POST /api/admin/affiliate/partners/invite` (`src/lib/affiliateEmailInvite.ts`) creates the partner with a placeholder random code and the address's local part as its name, under the organisation lock, and sends the invitation (409 `email_is_partner` / `email_taken`). The registration form lets the partner set its name (`partnerName`, 400 `name_invalid`) next to its code. Creating a partner with a fixed code moved under "Advanced" on the partners page (#3963).

en: Invite a partner with just an e-mail address — the partner chooses its name and referral code when signing up. Creating a partner with a fixed code is now under "Advanced".
tr: Bir partneri yalnızca e-posta adresiyle davet edebilirsin; partner adını ve referans kodunu kayıt olurken kendisi seçer. Sabit kodla partner oluşturma artık "Gelişmiş" altında.
de: Partner lassen sich jetzt allein mit ihrer E-Mail-Adresse einladen – Name und Empfehlungscode wählt der Partner bei der Registrierung. Das Anlegen mit festem Code steht jetzt unter „Erweitert“.
